title: 19th-century Baron Trump time-travel books
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 19th-century Baron Trump time-travel books, about 19th century at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Dawn and Baron Trump and their time traveling adventures, which is a book that was written, I think, also in the 19th century.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up a book called The Adventures of Baron Trump, which he says was written in the 19th century. He describes it as the story of a character named Baron Trump and his time-travelling adventures, alongside another figure he calls Dawn. Those who raise it see it as a possible hint that someone back then saw the future.
